name: Gilded Hourglass of Love
description: No time for love? Well this little hourglass might be the solution to your problem!

name: Gilded Knight Mace

name: Gilded Love Fan

name: Gingerbread Hammer of Cysero-Mas

name: Glacial Maul

description: Catch the waves in a perfect freeze frame.

name: Glacial Summer Surf Board (Non-AC)
description: Catch the waves in a perfect freeze frame.

name: Glory Hammer

name: Glowing BloodFire Axe
description: Slash and bash your enemies until they grow with fire and blood!

description: When this light approaches, pray for Death to take you first. The Ravens carrying this lantern aren't here to save you.

name: Glowing Caster's Skewer

description: After I smash you, then you will let out a goggle!

name: Goddess Of Love Spear
description: Love is a battlefield. To win, you need to have the power of a goddness on your side!

name: Godly Mace of the Ancients
description: This mace holds power like no one has ever seen before. The ground around you seems to quake in its presence.

name: Gold Chain and Hook
description: What used to be a pirate's fancy trick hand can be your next party surprise.

name: Gold Champion Chakram
description: All the nations of the world are united by the spirit of champions… and their country/facetion colors!

name: Gold Firework
description: Celebrate the New Year with this huge golden firework!

name: Gold Lycan Skull Mace
description: "Head" into battle with a gilded Lycan skull mace! With spikes on the skull,of course (but not on fire).

name: Gold Party Sign
description: Celebrate the New Year with this golden party sign!

name: Gold Sack
description: Wait, is the gold dropping after your victory your gold from the mace or the enemy's gold? Oh, well. Win-win. It's Lucky Day, and to celebrate… EVERY day will be lucky if you have this awesome gold-boosting sack of gold!

name: Gold ShadowFire SkullBringer
description: Civilization in the Shadowlands is centered around one thing - protect the Lords. When you wear this gear, none will dare cross you.

name: Golden Anchor Mace
description: A strikingly gold anchor that a rich pirate had no problem repeatedly tossing into the sea.

name: Golden Axe
description: "With a swing of my axe, you will hear my thunderous roar!"

name: Golden Borgar Flipper
description: Let the Fiery Dude take you all the way to Spicy Town!

name: Golden Bough (Mace)
description: Let the light of this golden bough guide you through the darkness.

name: Golden Bouquet
description: These are not NORMAL flowers… these golden roses are made from the power of love… and love hits HARD!

name: Golden Clover Cleaver (Mace)
description: A wee bit o luck is forged in these cleavers.

name: Golden Cobra Mace

name: Golden CowBell
description: NEEDS MOAR COWBELL

name: Golden Dream Guardian Dagger
description: There are many creatures that stalk the lands of the Djinn Realm, and the Guardians of the Dream Palace protect all who dwell within. Golden versions of the Guardian's uniform are awarded to those who have saved the lives of those who dwell in the realm.

name: Golden Flying Bacon Mace
description: FLYING BACON AWAY!!! This item has a chance to do the Golden Bacon Storm animation each time you auto-attack!

name: Golden Harmony Bouquet
description: Pure gold never tarnishes or rusts. May this love always stay the same.

name: Golden Infinity Dragon Hammer
description: This hammer has living jaws that bite and tear diamonds out from the mutated scapes of the Void. Though it's meant to chew through flesh, it mashes stone and steel just as easily.

name: Golden Kama
description: It slices and dices while making its enemies' bodies look not so nice…s?!

name: Golden Mace
description: A powerful mace of gold that was awarded to those who understand the true meaning of Frostval.

name: Golden Mirror Breaker
description: I'm sure he won't mind if you "borrow" his hammer for a little bit. I replaced the real one with a foam version. *snicker*

name: Golden Mug
description: A jolly toast to Lucky Day!

name: Golden Naval Commander Hook
description: Slash and scrape your way through ye enemies!

name: Golden Pisces Lyre
description: Legends of the Love Gods are intertwined with that of the Pisces Constellation. Valentidus and Lupercalia bless the compassionate strings of the Golden Pisces with their charm magic.

name: Golden Rose
description: These are not NORMAL flowers… this golden rose are made from the power of love… and love hits HARD!

name: Golden Royal Knight's Hammer
description: As the festive season approaches, Pactagonal Knights don their formal golden armor in order to brighten up the dark days.

name: Golden Shadow Breaker
description: This weapon can actually break shadows!

name: Golden Snowflake Sickle
description: Meant to break the ice and shine a little light. Beautiful, and a great tool for snowy rescues.

name: Golden Star
description: The only star that you do Not want to meet face to face.

name: Golden Trick Cane
description: The handle is very heavy. You could easily smash open a door, and that's the funny trick!

name: Golden Victor's Hammer
description: No matter how vast the invading army, no matter how massive the monster, no matter how powerful the villain… the heroes of Battleon will ALWAYS rise to defend their home. And battling together, they will ALWAYS win.

name: Golden Victory Torch
description: Let your aflame shine bright on your way to victory.

name: Golden Vihuela
description: Let the music move you… into BATTLE!

name: Golden Vinyl Record
description: This record is etched with the contents of the soul. It speaks to anyone who'll listen, and cuts anyone who doesn't.

name: Golden Waterpolo Ball
description: To the winner go the spoils!

name: GoldenPunisher
description: You unlocked this mace and the rest of the Royal Commander set when you become one of the Lore’s greatest Heroes with a 1 month upgrade!

name: Gong Ji Zhanshi Fan
description: This lovely fan will make you shine like royalty.

name: Gonzaga's Gilded Mace
description: Let the liquid sounds of the samba wash over you as you battle through Carnaval wielding this solid gold mace!

name: Good Football Mace
description: Have a ball. Literally.

description: Every strike doled out with the beast of a weapon chimes like a gong. Ask not for whom the bell tolls.

description: Quack-up at this ridiculous naval commander. Duck and waddle around your enemies while having a duckload of fun.

description: When you're wandering through a strange new realm, looking good means feeling confident. And confidence makes you a less attractive target for enemies.

description: Not only are you beating on them with a turkey leg, but you're using the skeleton's own hand to do it!

name: Grand Slammer
description: You never know when you'll need to SMASH a bad guy over the net! Commemorating the 2013 Australian Grand Open Tennis Championship!

name: Gravefang's Gold Anchor
description: A golden anchor that also acts as an enchanted totem. Its magic offsets the numerous weaknesses a crew of Werewolf/Vampire hybrids would be burdened with.

name: Gravelyn's DOOM Cannon (0 AC)
description: The ruler of the Shadowscythe calls on her loyal and bloodthirsty navy. Every corner of the seas will be dyed red by the crimson gaze of the Empire.

name: Gravelyn's DOOM Cannon (AC)
description: The ruler of the Shadowscythe calls on her loyal and bloodthirsty navy. Every corner of the seas will be dyed red by the crimson gaze of the Empire.

name: Gravelyn's LatoLato
description: Made from the carved scales of a Sulphur Dracolich, these look like a toy… to the unwary. But when the weighted ends of the latolato strike, the pain will be real. Gravelyn is unimpressed with those who cannot handle this deceptively simple implement of pain.

name: Gravity Defying Coffee Mug
description: A steaming cup of coffee that will never spill - the perfect gift for the AQWorld's best dad this Father's Day!

name: Gravy Boat
description: Mmmm. This delicious gravy was awarded the ShadowScythe Seal of Approval by the Empress of the ShadowFall.

name: Great Dragons Scroll
description: Take this to Dedara and you will be able to read the scroll.

name: Great Mace
description: What makes a mace great? Lots of sharp pointy bits on it. Where'd it come from? Best not to ask. It "showed up" in a recent shipment of… things… to the Odds Shop.

name: Great Mace of Flame
description: Maybe it's fueled by flame of war. Maybe it's just a really sweet fire mace. Either way, it's gonna hurt. A lot.

name: Great Ornate Warhammer
description: In times of troubling conflict, Gilead warriors wielded elaborate war hammers that reflected the great power of such a fantastic city. The work put into such weapons will forever be admired.

name: Greater Monstrous Claw (0 AC)
description: The Queen of Monsters' most zealous, loyal defenders have reshaped themselves in her image.

name: Greater Monstrous Claw (AC)
description: The Queen of Monsters' most zealous, loyal defenders have reshaped themselves in her image.

name: Green And Gold Boomer-ang
description: In an Olympic year, everything is Green and Gold!

name: Green Battle Glowstick
description: Light your way through any battle with this glowstick!

name: Green Crystal Goblet
description: Gothic Vampires only drink from the fanciest crystal.

name: Green Glowchucks (1)
description: Dancing with these glowsticks will keep everyone out of your personal bubble.

name: Green Glowchucks (2)
description: Oooh, glowy!

name: Green StarGuitar
description: A very rare guitar fit for a rock SUPERstar! Crafted by the same makers of the original Starsword. Thanks for buying the first NPC's album!

name: Green Swirly Candy Stick
description: Taking candy "crush" to a whole new level.

name: Green Water Balloon
description: Normally, your enemies wouldn't be harmed by a water balloon, but what if this balloon was filled with hot sauce? They wouldn't feel this extra heat coming.

name: Green Wedding Candle
description: The tag reads,"Keep away from flamable toys and guests who used too much hairspray."

name: Gremlin Wrench
description: There is no problem too big or small that a Gremlin Wrench can't fix. Or break further.

name: Gren's Cane
description: This golden cane bears the head of Roroth's personal merchant, Gren. Given only to those who love gold as much as Gren does!

name: Grey Tidal Tiger Warrior's Fan
description: Ward off misfortune with the strength of the tidal waves and bring good fortune with the ferocity of the Tiger!

name: Grilled Provolone Sandwich
description: NOM NOM NOM! This hearty sandwich is the perfect post-battle snack for a hero looking to refuel.

name: Grim Mace of Shadows
description: Using spells calling on the Shadow, these Battlemages are feared throughout the brighter parts of Lore.

name: Grim Rose Bouquet
description: Maybe if you give it this Grim Rose Bouquet to the ever-hungry Angler Empress as tribute, she won't hurt you… as much.

description: Maybe if you give it this Grim Rose to the ever-hungry Angler Empress as tribute, she won't hurt you… as much.

name: Grimoire of Abra-Melin
description: Theories about who the original mage was is heavily contested. The Mana Dreamers believe the first to bind a grimoire of magic spells was Abra-Melin, an Elf who could survive tapping into the mana from Lore's core.

name: Grimoire of the Dark Seas (0 AC)
description: A tome of dark arts pertaining to the specifics of casting at sea. All necromancy is the same, if you're an amateur. Real Dark Casters know how to rend the greatest amount of terror afforded by the ocean's bounty.

description: A tome of dark arts pertaining to the specifics of casting at sea. All necromancy is the same, if you're an amateur. Real Dark Casters know how to rend the greatest amount of terror afforded by the ocean's bounty.

description: This weapon is a fixture of the dungeons. Extremely effective yet easy to to drop, and always skids just an inch too far out of reach. It's a real knee-slapper for evil onlookers.

description: This hammer is visibly upset. You would be too if people used your head as a weapon!

name: Grumpy Warhammer
description: Beware! This steel plated hammer of war is cranky in the morning!

description: Designed by Blake Don, this massive maul has carries the spirit of a gryphon inside it, and has carved representation on its head. Your opponents - and friends for that matter - will not be able to lie around you while wielding this.

description: Anyone need a napkin? Careful they're hot!

description: This baby's waiting for an army to let loose on. When you run out of silver bullets, you can load it up with acorns. They'll prove just as fatal with the firepower to back them up.

description: An intricate war hammer that literally means "to vanquish" in Dwarfish.

description: A weapon that was definitely named by a Paladin. A malicious spirit is sealed inside. With each swing of this hammer, it dies a little more.

name: Hammer of Innocence
description: Ornate and beautiful, this hammer is ready to fight. Just surrender and it won't hurt at all.

description: If a bell in a town rings seven times at dawn, that means they align themselves with the Dawn Vindicators. It is to honor Gramiel, who destroyed a H'orc army in just seven strikes of his hammer.

name: Hammer of Vokun
description: Bestowed onto Vokun by members of the Forgotten Tombs, this hammer possess the ability to summon the dark arts. Only those who wield it will understand it's true purpose!

name: Hand of Serket
description: Scorpion venom was purified and crystallized into the shape of a pincer. Though primarily wielded in combat, it was originally intended for use in surgery. Patients were understandably frightened.

description: WHOOOOOOPIEEEEEEEEE!

description: If you want Heroes to respect you, show them you're serious. Blow something up!

name: Harm 'O Nee
description: A Frozen Northlands war hammer that brings to battle anything harmony!

description: A special magic orb atuned to the Libra constellation. It disperses and shares the mana of your companions, connecting your minds and dreams.

name: Harmonic Libra's Tome
description: A tome containing maths, sciences, poems, and dreams. The young student immortalized in the stars left behind a book that will always have pages ready to be filled by knew knowledge and ideas.

name: Harpies Juice Barrel
description: You just can't tailgate party without a keg full of Moglinberry juice!

name: Harvest Squash-er
description: Unleash a cornucopia of vengeance against the opposition!

name: Haunted Gravestone
description: Beware of the pocong; some of them are just friends playing pranks or random gymbros, but if you're unlucky enough, you might find the real ones!

name: Haunted Storybook
description: Liber manes mysteria.

name: Haunted Storybook +15
description: Liber manes mysteria. (15% bonus to exp)

name: Haunted Tuanshan
description: There was once a beautiful design of spring flowers and newborn birds. All of that faded with time and a lonely death. (CC to Base,Accessory)

description: What are you up to? Necromancy? Toxic Pyromancy? Or are you trying to stir up a birthday party?

description: What are you up to? Necromancy? Toxic Pyromancy? Or are you trying to stir up a birthday party?

description: If you pound this mace into your foes chest enough, you are certain to break their heart… and a few other things.

description: Yummm! This is the perfect gift to give YOURSELF this Hero's Heart Day! Because every hero needs a little sweetness to balance out the dark (chocolate).

name: Heartstone Warhammer

description: This gilded prize is a memento of your victory in battle against Helsdottir in the Northlands grove.

description: Helsgrove Guardians protect their mistress, Helsdottir, as she hunts down fools trying to outrun her retribution.

description: Save the world with a mace made of steel!

description: Save the world with a mace made of steel!

description: Literal. Magitech Mages have the ability to use the lowest level of tech… or the highest.

description: If the car breaks down, at least you can jump out and key the other guy's ride.

name: High Octane Racer Mace
description: A helmet designed to protect your skull, and wreck everyone else's.

name: High-Voltage Conductor
description: Touch this and your hair will stand on end! ( If you don't get thrown all the way across the room, that is!)

name: Hikari Attack Plushie
description: A cute and cuddly little plushie of someone you might recognize.

name: History of Lore Tome
description: A wise hero studies the victorious warriors that came before them. That is how you learn and avoid making the same mistakes. (This item is color customizable.)

name: Holiday Flail
description: When you need to really "ring" the holiday spirit into someone.

name: Holiday Paragon Hammer of Light
description: Members of the Bright Legion love Frostval… the sun shining on their armor and snow blinds their enemies and makes them look even MORE Good.

name: Hollow Oni Kama
description: The Oni believe that the divide between them and human beings is paper-thin. When night falls, and violence reigns, enraged farmers become indistinguishable from Oni in revelry.

name: Hollowborn Alchemist's Shrunken Head
description: Expert transmutationists, Hollowborn Alchemists are the masters of mutable magic. Their power lies in transforming objects into new states of being. The Shadow Fiend has granted them the ability to change the very nature of reality.

name: Hollowborn Apocalypse Flame
description: When the last star dies and the last soul fizzles into nothingness, will there still be Hollowborn journeying through the dark?

name: Hollowborn Battlemage Hammer
description: Though the Hollowborn are given new life in the shade of the Shadow Fiend, its power serves whichever goals they pursue. This hammer can smite the Light, or make Darkness grovel, so long as there is sufficent drive.

name: Hollowborn Beach Board (AC)
description: Could a surfer become Hollowborn after getting eaten by a shark, meeting the Shadow Fiend, and overcoming death? Well, a real surfer's need to shred the waves could conquer any fear. (Glow is customizable to eye color.)

name: Hollowborn Beach Board (Non-AC)
description: Could a surfer become Hollowborn after getting eaten by a shark, meeting the Shadow Fiend, and overcoming death? Well, a real surfer's need to shred the waves could conquer any fear. (Glow is customizable to eye color.)

description: "You do know what time it is, right?"

name: Hollowborn Carrion Lantern
description: When this light approaches, pray for your strength to return. You must pass their test, or everything you own down to your name will be taken by the Ravens.

name: Hollowborn Cleaver
description: Always searching for ways to obtain more power, the Hollowborn Adept studies all types of combat. May the shadow fiend show you new paths and guide your lessons.

name: Hollowborn Dark Orb (0 AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as HollowBorns!

name: Hollowborn Decimation
description: Power and strength are the highest virtues of the Hollowborn Shadowslayers. Nothing less than the total eradication of all obstacles is acceptable.

name: Hollowborn DreamWalker's Claw
description: Some DreamWalkers can send their minds through dreams and dimensions to get information or watch their enemies, but Hollowborn DreamWalkers are able to go there personally if needed. Though it is a gift from the Shadow Fiend to do such thing, it comes with a  price.

name: Hollowborn Druid Spike
description: The runes were originally the written form of the murmurs from the wellspring of all life. Everyone can understand them the moment they are born, but the language is lost as one's bonds to the natural world erodes.

description: Under the jurisdiction of the Hollowborn Judge, the defendant has only two options: confession or denial. If they're guilty, they must confess. If they are innocent, they must accept true justice.

name: Hollowborn Soul Keeper
description: Let the Shadow Fiend light your path hero. Walk the path of a true champion.

name: Hollowborn Thunderlord Lightning
description: The power of thunder and lightning is a difficult one to wield - one that only the most determined of Hollowborn can master.

name: Hollowborn Treasure Hunter Necklace
description: An unassuming necklace with multiple uses. Look closely, and you'll find that it functions as a compass, a timer, a poisonous gas detector, and a panic button for your brethren to come pick you up. Now that's Hollowborn magic.

name: Hollowborn Vade Mecum
description: As a Chain Novel, the principles and rules dictated by the Hollowborn Judge for the most diverse situations, what has been decided in the past and what will be, in the future, must be registered as a mark of their jurisprudence.

name: Hollowborn Wedding Bouquet
description: Thay grew the flowers in her garden with Lae's help. The bouquet is filled with memories of their Hollowborn life together.

name: Hollowborn Wedding Candle
description: Lae was handing these out to guests at his wedding. No matter how long they burn, the wax won't melt. Thay must have worked a little magic.

name: Hollowborn Wedding Mug
description: It was really nice of Lae and Thay to let the guests take these home. It doesn't matter what you pour into the mug. The drink will bubble and warm on its own. Too bad it doesn't change into the color of your soul too.

name: Holo DataKnight Claws
description: Battle alongside the Dragons of Time as you attempt to command the universe!

name: Holy Hammer of Retribution
description: This mace is usually wielded by warriors of light who fight endlessly to destroy evil, and defend the weak. It's a tough job but someones gotta do it.

name: Honey Bat
description: This sweet treat can't BEE beat… but you CAN use it to beat up your opponents!

name: Horc Club
description: It's a club you don't want to join…

name: Hourglass of the Fae
description: Perhaps this holds a key to how Time Travel Fairies get all those interesting items.

name: Iadoa Plushie Mace
description: Dawww! Made from the Birthday Cake's Hero Plushie and Chaorrupted Button Eyes… Who ever thought the 10th Lord of Chaos would be THIS CUTE as a plushie?!

name: Iara's Brush
description: (This item deals 35% more damage to all monsters when equipped.) They tried to drown Iara, yet she was saved. Those who work to prevent this from ever happening again carry this.

name: Iara's Harp
description: They tried to drown her, yet she was saved. Coral from Iara's new home was used to create this harp.

name: Iara's Mirror Mace
description: Your will was tested, and you prevailed. Carry Iara's mirror with you as a symbol of your victory.

name: Ice Claw (Mace)
description: Slice through ChaosWeavers with the power of Ice!

name: Ice Cold Karambit (0 AC)
description: Some say the world will end in fire, some say in ice. From what I've seen of battles dire, I hold with those who favor fire. But if it had to perish twice, I think I know enough of hate to prefer ice.

name: Ice Cold Karambit (AC)
description: Some say the world will end in fire, some say in ice. From what I've seen of battles dire, I hold with those who favor fire. But if it had to perish twice, I think I know enough of hate to prefer ice.

name: Ice Cream Cone
description: Everyone will scream when they see you with this Ice Cream! The damage percentage equals its saturated fat content. Awesome!

name: Ice Flower Mace
description: Too cold to hold…

description: Powered by energy made of ice particles, this is more than just a screwdriver! Use it to open locks, rewire computers and neutralize wooden torches! Click to reveal the blade.

name: Ice Wizard's Tome
description: These elemental wizards gain their power from Ice, which is why you mostly see them in the winter months… especially around Frostval.

name: Icebound Contract of the Archfiend
description: This is the contract that binds the VoidFrost Revenant of Nulgath. In exchange for an Evil act accomplished by the Archfiend himself, the Revenants not only gave up their futures, but potentially the destinies of all life.

name: Icy Bone-quet
description: Even undead mothers love a gift on Mother's Day! Happy Mother's Day!

name: Icy Frostlorn Raider Hammer
description: The Winter Raiders use this style of weapon in fighting off the great white wyrms of the northlands.

name: Icy Frostlorn Raider Mace
description: Each of the four frostbitten blades on the head of this brutal mace can deliver massive damage.

name: Icy Frostlorn Sickle
description: The icy rift has spilled not only monsters into Lore, but also LOOT! Happy Frostval!

name: Ignis Core Rod
description: The crystal is a prison for rebellious FIre Elementals. It's their rage and frustration that makes this staff perfect for conjuring fiery spells.

name: Illusionary Pocket Watch
description: It's easy to mess with time. All you need to do is change your perception.

name: Illusionary Royal Flush
description: Blink, and they'll show you new faces.

name: Illusionary Trick Card
description: Blink, and it'll show you a new face.

name: Impish Water Wings
description: It squeaks when you squeeze it, but sometimes it shouts "Ow!" H-hello? Are you alive? Did you get cursed?

description: Some of Yue's customers are Oni who belong to Torakuma-Doji's clan. She designed battle fans to fit how their bloodthirsry nature and penchent for the adorable exists in harmony. Of course, she's terrified whenever they visit.

description: Some of Yue's customers are Oni who belong to Torakuma-Doji's clan. She designed gourds to fit how their bloodthirsty nature and penchant for the adorable exists in harmony. Of course, she's terrified whenever they visit.

name: Inclination for Incantations
description: Knowledge is like air to a flame, it keeps you alive.

name: Ineffable Hourglass
description: Found in an ex-convent it somehow found its way ineffably to Sora.

name: Infernal Hunter Baton
description: It packs a shock as devastating as divine lightning.

name: Infernal Invoker's Tome
description: The flames of magic and power rise within you. Lite the embers and ignite your enemies!

name: Infernal Short Starsaber

description: Lost souls wander the underworld. Those who retain a measure of their strength and skill may be recruited into the Infernal Underworld Army. They guard the realm itself, unattached to any faction.

name: Infernus Guardian's Mace
description: Infernus Guardians are charged with protecting the entrance to the Plane of Fire by the Avatar of Fire, Fiamme. Fueled by the fires of dedication and loyalty, they are incorruptible.

name: Infinity Titan Power Mace
description: The hardest choices requires the stronger will. The end is near, but you have the strength of will to act on those choices. Never forget.

name: Invoker Book Mace
description: All the invoker's divine magic cannot simple be suppressed into one book but this will help you on your quests. (Gives 15% more rep and 3% more Class Points when equipped)

name: Ionic Dirk (AC)
description: Some of the most powerful forces on our world are too small to see… but Ionic Warriors can manipulate the very building blocks of energy and matter to ensure they are victorious.

name: Ionic Dirk (Non-AC)

name: Unidentified 16 (Iron Plate Hammer)

name: iTeka Plushie Mace

name: Jack's Haunted Treat Bucket
description: MUAHAHAHA! A deep, dark laugh rings out as you equip these. That's… that's fine, right? Nothing wrong with a good, hearty chuckle from an invisible companion. Right.

name: Jumbo Pencil
description: REALLY write your way into the history books!

description: Kamaitachi is known as a sickle weasel so have fun with that bit of information.

name: Kawaii Gecko Plushie
description: They're no Dragon, but their gallant heart is as big as one!

description: Well done, you've acquired the fabled Dragon Blood Hourglass. Legend says the sand is actually crystallized blood of Vasalkar, the Red Dragon. Though how this was done and by whom is unknown. Sora To Hoshi will be pleased you got this on her birthday.

name: Key of Eternal Joy
description: A fragment of a lively night shining in the coldest days of the year. The warmth from those memories will always be within reach.

name: Kezeroth's Devastation
description: This is one of the massive warhammers that Kezeroth wields with ease.

name: Khasaanda Plushie Mace
description: Dawww! Made from the Birthday Cake's Hero Plushie and Chaorrupted Button Eyes… Who ever thought the 9th Lord of Chaos would be THIS CUTE as a plushie?!

description: Dawww! Made from the Birthday Cake's Hero Plushie and Chaorrupted Button Eyes… Who ever thought the 6th Lord of Chaos would be THIS CUTE as a plushie?!

name: King Alteon's Golden Mace
description: Alteon's sword is instantly recognizable, but he always had a fondness for blunt, straight-to-the-point maces. That used to get him in all sorts of trouble, which he can't afford anymore. Lynaria and Valen aren’t around to get him out of it.

name: Kitchen Sink
description: You have thrown everything else against your foe… so why not throw the sink at him! Etched on the side it says <player's name hidden>.

description: You swing kitty? You swing kitty like a mace? Jail! Jail for one thousand years!

name: Kitty Kawaii Bat
description: What is yours is mine, and if claws won't make you belieive that, then some blunt force trauma should do. Think of me in your concussed dreams.

description: As your mother says: "Careful! Someone's going to put a knee out with this thing!"

name: Knight Mace
description: The old fashioned way of bashing a skull in hasn't gone out of style.

name: Knighthood Condemnation
description: The greatest hate you can ever feel is always directed at yourself. That's why the Visionaries are so relentless when they destroy noble knights - a perfect picture of who they used to be.

name: Knuckle Sword of Madness
description: The giftbox unwraps to reveal a weapon of eldritch horror… and devastating holiday power. Perfect to /SLAY all year long!

description: *No description*

description: This small summer Kota Bear plushie is soft and cuddly, and makes a perfect weapon… if you want to kill your enemies with cuteness! (This item is color-customizable to Trim)

description: Spike it at your enemy!.. or flail at them with it.

name: KotaBear 023S
description: Smug teddybears are disconcerting.

description: A cute and cuddly little plushie of someone you might recognize.

name: Kotaro's Baby Pillow
description: I couldn't let go of my baby pillow hero, however if you want it, i can give you my baby pillow from an alternate dimension. Please do take care of it /cry.

description: No shield or armor can withstand attacks from this mighty weapon for long.

description: There were a number of extremities that had to be cut off of Creature 10. Re played around with the leftovers, and gave the Chimera what she called "utensils." She set them loose, and told them to go make their own lunch.

description: A demured weapon for a sophisticated Hero.

name: Lae Plushie Mace
description: Good to boop with your enemies on the head with!

description: Legion DeathFiends are sworn body and soul to Dage the Evil's Undead Legion. They stalk the edges of the Underworld looking for unwary victims.

name: Lovely Rocker's Bass
description: The lodestone of a band. Insult the bass at your own peril.

description: Count the drum beats like this: Tsun. Tsun. Tsun. Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-TsunTsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun.

name: Lovely Rocker's Guitar
description: An Atlantica 612 guitar model that's seen a lot of love!

name: Lovely Rocker's Keytar
description: An electric revitalization of a classic.

name: Lovesick Infernal Hammer
description: Your volatile emotions feed this Infernal hammer to the point that it's bursting from an overcharge. May you strike your love true. (Click to transform)

name: Loyalist Juice Barrel
description: You just can't tailgate party without a keg full of Moglinberry juice!

name: Luckier One Leaf Clover
description: Might as well leaf this one, you won't be clover-ing anyone with it. Happy Unlucky Day 2015, you're going to need nedd it.

name: Luckier Red Envelope
description: What luck! You got an even luckier red envelope for the Chinese New Year. You can sell it or use it to beat up bad spirits! Be careful not to get a paper cut!

name: Lucky Ball and Chain
description: If you lost your lucky ball and chain, you're in luck because we've found a ferocious stand-in!. And THIS one can be used as a wicked weapon.

name: Lucky Hammer
description: What luck! Thousands of battles and yet this hammer is still in tact (for the most part). Happy Lucky Day!

name: Lucky Red Envelope
description: What luck! You got a lucky red envelope for the Chinese New Year. You can sell it or use it to beat up bad spirits! Be careful not to get a paper cut!

name: Luma Torch of Celerity
description: "Celerity" has to do with speed and swiftness. The Lightguard named this torch with the Avatar of Light in mind. The act of flattery comes off as dense, and makes her look self-centered.

name: Luma Torch of Clarity
description: One of the torches from Fort Luma that hold the stolen flames of Citrinitas. Its gold has tarnished, and the enlightenment it once imparted has lost its meaning.

name: Lunamoss Claw Mace
description: The claw of Lunamoss brings life to whatever it touches.

name: Lunarian Gohei
description: This is one of the best weapons available for an Astromancer training to learn the ways of the Moon.

name: Lunarian Trainee Mallet
description: A replica of the tools the moon rabbits use to pound mochi. Getting your hand struck by one hurts pretty bad. Pounding a head is something the real moon rabbits think about a lot.

name: Lute
description: A traditional stringed instrument commonly played by Bards. But no one is too sure as to what kind of monster drops this lute…

name: LuxTech HP Fuel
description: Wear this during your next Let's Play stream and your followers will love you! (And your subs will skyrocket.)

name: Lycan Eternal Flame Mace
description: For the children of the moon.

name: Lycan's Anti-Vamp Club
description: Perfect for taking down a vampire… or seasoning your steak (make sure you do not try to eat your stake).

name: Lynaria's Hammer
description: One of the Champion of Lights weapons, and possibly the last found intact. As the healer and lodestone of her trio, Lynaria made sure she could hold her own in a fight. If she went down, so would Valen and Alden.

name: Lyre of Cheer
description: Hark! Do ye have a festive song for us?

name: Macabre Horror Hammer
description: Oh, no. Ew. OW. Whyyyyy? What fresh horror is this?!

name: Mace of Cold
description: This mace is as freezing as the Elemental you found it on.

name: Mace of Destiny
description: For truth, justice, and the ability to vanquish all foes!

name: Mace of Enn'tröpy
description: Intended to eliminate heresy. The inquisitors were so intimidating, even the innocent would admit guilt. Therefore, sealing their fate.

name: Mace of Flame
description: Flame runes have been wrought into the metal of this mace releasing it's contained heat only when slammed into your foe.

name: Mace of Misery
description: All shall perish at the might of this mace!

name: Mace of Moor
description: A Mudluk mace perfect for those warriors looking to inflict "moor" damage against their swamp foes.

name: Mace of Purified Souls
description: A half-purified, but still mighty mace that could smite the light and darkness alike.

name: Mace of Strange Bones
description: A curious glow oozes from this weapon, crafted of the bones of mind-twisting monstrosities.

name: Mace of the Blessed Inquisitor
description: Intended to eliminate heresy! The Inquisitors were so intimidating, even the innocent would admit guilt. Therefore sealing their fate.

name: Mace of the Fiend
description: This mace was crafted out of a terrible fiend from the Underworld. It now serves as a great bludgeoning device.

name: Mace of the Grand Inquisitor
description: Intending to eliminate heresy. The Inquisitors were so intimidating, even the innocent would admit guilt. Therefore, sealing their fate.

name: Mace of the Light
description: For honor… for glory… we BATTLE ON!

name: Mad WeaponSmith's Hammer (0 AC)
description: A couple of whacks with this hammer can turn iron into a houseplant. Not meant to be used as a weapon but if you are, go absolutely wild.

name: Mad WeaponSmith's Hammer (AC)
description: A couple of whacks with this hammer can turn iron into a houseplant. Not meant to be used as a weapon but if you are, go absolutely wild.

name: Magical Bean Twig
description: It's so soft! The insides must be made of ice cream and fish paste.

name: Magical Bean Twilly
description: How huggable! Or biteable? Maybe both?

name: Magical Gecko Action Figure
description: Eye of newt and toe of frog, Wool of bat and tongue of dog - but absolutely no gecko parts in your magic potion!

name: Magical Hammer Of Time (0 AC)
description: It sparkles when you bonk an enemy into the last century. But only if you remember to call out your attack.

name: Magical Hammer Of Time (AC)
description: It sparkles when you bonk an enemy into the last century. But only if you remember to call out your attack.

name: Magitech Clawblade (AC)
description: A blade that has yet to reach its full potential. The blueprints were made by engineers who are inventing ways to use time as fuel. There is a being out there who is Time itself, so if they can acquire one of its body parts…

name: Magitech Clawblade (Non-AC)
description: A blade that has yet to reach its full potential. The blueprints were made by engineers who are inventing ways to use time as fuel. There is a being out there who is Time itself, so if they can acquire one of its body parts…

name: Magitech Time Sigil (0 AC)
description: Instead of finding ways to travel through time, magitech engineers are inventing ways to make time move around them. This is incredibly dangerous magic, a product of hubris instead of altruistic creation.

name: Magitech Time Sigil (AC)
description: Instead of finding ways to travel through time, magitech engineers are inventing ways to make time move around them. This is incredibly dangerous magic that is a product of hubris instead of altruistic creation.

name: Magmagilt Kama
description: It's only right that you keep it as a reward.

name: Magnifying Glass
description: Now that you have a magnifying glass you can be a sleuth JUST like the great Hemlock Bones!

name: Magus of Nulgath Grimoire (AC)
description: Of the spells Nulgath crafted for himself, few are allowed to be written down in ink. They must be recorded in his own blood, or the spells viciously backfire on the caster.

name: Magus of Nulgath Grimoire (Non-AC)
description: Of the spells Nulgath crafted for himself, few are allowed to be written down in ink. They must be recorded in his own blood, or the spells viciously backfire on the caster.

name: Malefic Curse Cannon (0 AC)
description: A cannon that fires curses and hate instead of gunpowder and cannon balls. One strike and your ship's fate is sealed to its watery grave.

name: Malefic Curse Cannon (AC)
description: A cannon that fires curses and hate instead of gunpowder and cannon balls. One strike and your ship's fate is sealed to its watery grave.

name: Malevolent Hourglass
description: Something about this hourglass… it's almost as you hear a dark voice in your head telling you to use it.

name: Malgor's LatoLato
description: Made from the carved scales of a Sulphur Dracolich, these look like a toy… to the unwary. But when the weighted ends of the latolato strike, the pain will be real. The shame you feel at hitting yourself amuses Malgor.

name: Mallet of Vindication (AC)
description: The vindication continues… even across the seven seas!

name: Mallet of Vindication (Legend)
description: The vindication continues… even across the seven seas!

name: Mallow Hammer
description: Be careful when you swing this… and don't get it hot! So sticky.

name: Mana Creation Orb
description: A small accident made when Warlic and Tara were trying to make a gift for you. It's an orb that breaks several laws of manadynamics. It could pop a hole in reality, but you'll handle it responsibly.

name: Mana Crystals
description: Snow obeys your every whim.

name: Mana Flame Torch
description: The endless potential of mana is dangerous. Such a thing could be said about new ideas and youth. Warlic imparted that wisdeom to Tara, and with great care, she lit torches that would light your way and protect you.

name: Mana Guardian's Hammer
description: The Mana Core contains the most pure magic available. Any mage drawing from the Core would be flooded with pure magic, overcome in a deluge of power which would burn through their physical, mental, and magical veins. It MUST be guarded to protect our world.

name: Mana Mallet
description: This weapon will turn mana into pulp!

name: Manana Cleaver
description: Like with their strange and terrifying natural predators, you should never give Mananas knives.

name: Maniacal Neko Mace
description: This…isn't actually a Maneki Neko, is it? They got too much of a foul mouth to give anyone good fortune.

name: Manticore Head Mace
description: Nothing says "I'm awesome" like making a manticore's head and talk into a weapon.

name: Map in a Bottle
description: This piece of flotsam washed up on the shore. I wonder what the paper inside says? O_O

name: Maracas
description: Shake your rumba shakers! It is crafted from dried calabash filled with seeds and a few dried beans. Normally they come in pairs, but a Dragon ate the other one. Happy Cinco de Mayo!

name: Marsh Flame
description: A weapon found in the long lost depths of a marsh.

name: Martial Master Nunchuck
description: A weapon that requires quick hand movements and tight focus, which makes them effective training tool as well. Supposedly, an Emperor invented the nunchucks, and they were completely made of bronze as opposed to wood.

name: Martial White Lotus Rune
description: The rune is a spiral of petals, growing and dying. Flowers wilt. Snow melts. One's time is limited, so you must make it count.

name: Mary's Blaster Bomb (0 AC)
description: The life of a privateer is a hard one, but rewarding. Please the Crown and riches will find you… but not without bloodshed and battle.

name: Mary's Blaster Bomb (AC)
description: The life of a privateer is a hard one, but rewarding. Please the Crown and riches will find you… but not without bloodshed and battle.

name: Math Notebook
description: You might be better at math if you knew which student's mind to read. Just… make sure not to write anyone's name down. :|

name: Maul of the Mauler
description: Chaos never fights fair. Especially when using this overpowered over-sized maul hammer.

name: Mauling Stick
description: Horcs know hero needs weapons. Big ones. Horcs know hero wants big weapon recycled from the enemy to crush the enemy!

name: MC Miko's Enchanted Microphone
description: Dropping the sickest music outta Yokai Isle!

name: MC Miko's Microphone
description: Dropping the sickest music outta Yokai Isle!

name: MC Runty Plush
description: The strangest things happen around Cemaros' birthday… BECAUSE CHAOS!

name: McHammer
description: Uh oh, here comes the hammer!

name: Meanest Girl's Weapon
description: The Burn Book does WAY more damage than the Death Notebook.

name: Meat on a Stick
description: A deadly BBQ Fork used to skewer anything on the battlefield. Do your wurst!!… on a stick.

name: Meat on a Stick +5
description: A deadly BBQ Fork that does 5% more damage to dragons on the battlefield. Do your wurst!!… on a stick.

name: Mecha Hammer
description: Pressing the red button at the center is highly inadvisable. It might end the worlds. On the other hand, it might also dispense delicious candy!

name: Mediator Armblade
description: High-frequency armblade for close quarter situations.

name: Medium Rare Horc Chopper
description: For those who like their steak a little more cooked…

name: Melodic Ice Crystal
description: An orb of concentrated ice magic, created by Glace when her corpse was possesssed by a fallen god. The orb sings as it generates icy magic instead of consuming mana to cast spells.

name: Melon Chappal
description: Sometimes you just have to slap someone with a flip-flop or two.

name: Memento Mori
description: Remember when you enter the Blackhorn Tomb, you must die!

name: Memento Mori Mace
description: May no soul, mortal or immortal, ever be forgotten…

name: Memet Plushie Mace
description: This plushie should look like a NIGHTMARE, but it's too cute. Maybe it's a dream? *thinking*

name: Merciful Bludgeon
description: This is a burden the wanderer carries on their shoulders, across deserts and badlands, hoping its purpose will turn into something that helps the world grow instead of die.

name: Metal Claw
description: Slice through ChaosWeavers with the power of Metal

name: Micro-Giant's Blade
description: A brutal longsword crafted by the Micro-Giants weapon maker.

name: Midnight Beach Boombox (0 AC)
description: Keep it cool at your next beach party… even when things heat up!

name: Midnight Beach Boombox (AC)
description: Keep it cool at your next beach party… even when things heat up!

name: Midnight Nutcracker Mace
description: More elegant than an actual weapon, this mace still does damage.

name: Midnight Skull
description: Some would say that this skull of shadows is pretty headstrong…

name: Midnight Unicorn Plushie
description: A comfy companion that will find you if you're lost in dreams, and rescue you from nightmares.

name: Midnight Unicorn Plushie XL
description: A comfy companion that will find you if you're lost in dreams, and rescue you from nightmares.

name: Midnight Unicorn Toy
description: A comfy companion that will find you if you're lost in dreams, and rescue you from nightmares.

name: Mighty Horc Club
description: It's a club you don't want to join.. This is so much more mighty than the Horc Club. Damage range increases to 75.

name: Mighty Molten Mace
description: Wield the blazing force of fire in your hand. Call upon a firestorm!

name: Mikey's Hatchet
description: Mikey better clean that Moglinberry Smoothie off his axe blade or it'll start to rust.

name: Milanesa And Mashed Potatoes
description: NOM NOM NOM! This hearty dish is the perfect post-battle meal for a hero looking to refuel.

name: Miners Juice Barrel
description: You just can't tailgate party without a keg full of Moglinberry juice!

name: Moglin Teddy Mace
description: Liesel's teddy has been all cleaned up, and now you have one for your very own.

name: Moglinberry Smoothie Mug
description: Moglins love smoothies just as much as anyone else!

name: MogliTech Smasher
description: Battlenator 7: Rise of the MOGBOTS.

name: Moist Water Bottle
description: The only water bottle you'll ever need.

name: Molten Dragon's Claw
description: This mace has been crafted from the talons of a defeated great fire dragon. The magical heat coming off this weapon is enough to burn your enemy to ashes before it even hits them.

name: Molten Lava Orb
description: A ball of molten lava harvested from the scar of a volcano. It is said that if one bathes in the fires that Kalayo protects, they will transform into a dragon themselves. No intruder has ever succeeded - they were turned to ash for their mortal folly.

name: Molten Morningstar
description: A weapon created by the Sunborn when they found that on Lore, paintings of their home depicted its rays as spikes. The core is made of hardening plasma and its golden metallic rays shift and move.

name: Molten Orb Mace (0 AC)
description: These flames burn so hot, even the pressure of the deep ocean couldn't smother them.

name: Molten Orb Mace (AC)
description: These flames burn so hot, even the pressure of the deep ocean couldn't smother them.

name: Monster Pom Poms
description: Cheer on your cheesy team with these bladed Pom Poms!

name: MonsterLord Reaver
description: In a different world, a different timeline, Drakath -- Champion of Chaos -- would have been the MonsterLord, heir to the Queen of Monsters. But this is not that world, and he has seized his own power, and his own destiny.

name: Monstrous Claw (AC)
description: The Queen of Monsters' most zealous, loyal defenders have reshaped themselves in her image.

name: Monstrous Claw (Non-AC)
description: The Queen of Monsters' most zealous, loyal defenders have reshaped themselves in her image.

name: Moonlight Hunter's Candle
description: The power of the Moon keeps these hunters warm and guides their way on every mission.

name: Moonlit Tome
description: A forbidden book of spells that can only be read under moonlight. (This present was ONLY available for 16th Upholders. It opened during our 16th Birthday Celebration. )

name: Morning Star
description: It's great for bashing in your enemy's shiny armor. Hmmm… seems the Zardman boss holds another unique mace now.

name: Morningstar in Shadow
description: The silver moon illuminates the night sky along with the starry constellations. Moonborn Guardians have taken a piece of the night sky to carve proof of their existence into the history of Lore.

name: Mortal Fiend Armblade
description: Big and sharp. A proper weapon for a high rank fiend.

name: Mortal Fiend Claw
description: A pretty handy tool, which any Fiend would have fun with. Pity of your victims.

name: Mortal Fiend Reaver
description: A proper weapon for a high rank fiend.

name: Mother's Day Bouquet
description: Show your mom how much you care by beating monsters to a pulp with this beautiful bouquet! Happy Mother's Day!

name: Mother's Pride Bouquet
description: Give this bouquest to the best mother (or metherly person) a hero could have!

name: Mr. Strawberry Sparkle
description: You've found Bydis' plushie. You should hold on to it until you find her. Wonder where she went…

name: Mr. Wubbles Mace
description: BEAT THE STUFFING OUT OF YOUR ENEMIES!

name: Munthor's Stone Hammer
description: The rough, chiseled hammer of Munthor, leader of the Micro-Giants.

name: Mushroom (Mace)
description: This wont give you an extra life, but it will provide a 1-up on the monsters you battle!

name: Musical Cow Bell
description: Need more cow bell? Here's the perfect solution!

name: Mutative Broodfiend Dagger (0 AC)
description: Like many of the Nation's weapons, these barbs grow from the Broodfiend's own body. The more painful the process is, the deadlier the blade will be.

name: Mutative Broodfiend Dagger (AC)
description: Like many of the Nation's weapons, these barbs grow from the Broodfiend's own body. The more painful the process is, the deadlier the blade will be.

name: Mystcroft Disciple's Plushie
description: Treat your tricky enemies with the deadliest threat they'll ever see… the LAST thing they'll ever see.

name: Mysteriously Glowing Book
description: Mysterious!

name: Mystic Water Floatie (AC)
description: It's been enchanted by concerned denizens of the seas. The floatie can withstand the crush of a castle-sized wave, saving the ocean floor from more clutter.

name: Mystic Water Floatie (Non-AC)
description: It's been enchanted by concerned denizens of the seas. The floatie can withstand the crush of a castle-sized wave, saving the ocean floor from more clutter.

name: Mystical Chakram Of Illusions
description: Conjure and destroy - the fighting style that complements the chakrams confuses the enemy with illusions. The fight must end with the destruction of both enemy and lies.

name: Mystical Glass Orb
description: Let the music and magic of the Black Labyrinth entice you. Give in to the spell the Goblin King weaves. Your fate is in his hands.

name: Mystical Poison Orb
description: Channel the arcane through this cute, but deadly parasitic little orb. Even Vayle would be envious of its power! Watch your back the next time you set food into Doomwood with it.

name: Mystical Underworld Mug
description: Raise a mug and cheer AE's Anniversary!

name: Mythic DragonMaster Orb
description: These spheres of pure energy are not entirely solid yet they emit two aura rings in order to grant protection to their user.

name: Narakan Fiend's ArmBlade
description: Having risen from the deepest dethos of the Underworld, the Narakan Fiend has allied with Nulgath to destroy the Undead Legion.

name: Narwhal Plushie
description: The unicorn of the sea!

name: Nation Covenant of Bone
description: Ever loyal to Master Nulgath, the Nation's greatest loyalists serve the Archfiend even in death. Their souls cling to their bones, waiting for another chance to prove themselves.

name: Nation Phalanx Arm Blade (0 AC)
description: There used to be a sheathe but with surprise fights happening all the time, it became a hinderance.

name: Nation Phalanx Arm Blade (AC)
description: There used to be a sheathe but with surprise fights happening all the time, it became a hinderance.

name: Nation Phalanx Dagger (0 AC)
description: On closer inspection, the blade is two-pronged. Most of the unruly Nation minions do get that close look when they're disciplined for insubordination.

name: Nation Phalanx Dagger (AC)
description: On closer inspection, the blade is two-pronged. Most of the unruly Nation minions do get that close look when they're disciplined for insubordination.

name: Nation Ritualist's Swirling Sigil
description: The incantations and runes of the Nation swirl around the hands of the ritualist. They give their wielder untold knowledge and power, but will never let go.

name: Nation Thaumaturgy Tome
description: A book of great evil and calamity that leads those who read it to losing their souls. To the Nation, it's a tome of miracles and wonders penned by a scholar called Casimir.

name: National Treasure Map
description: The Lord of War is a National Treasure. With this map, you COULD find him, if he wasn't Wild at Heart, and already Gone in Sixty Seconds.

name: Nature Claw
description: Slice through ChaosWeavers with the power of Nature!

name: Naval Cow-mander's Stamp
description: You've been branded by a brand brand.

name: Necrayaya's Guitar
description: Celebrate Cinco de Mayo! When the band is made up of undead mariachi musicians, the /party will NEVER stop!

name: Necrayaya's GuitarCase
description: Celebrate Cinco de Mayo! When the band is made up of undead mariachi musicians, the /party will NEVER stop!

name: Necro Chakram (Mace)
description: Throw these at your enemies or play fetch with your dragon.

name: Necro Crewmember's Keg
description: *No description*

name: Necro Hourglass
description: Legend says that the owner of this hourglass can summon the undead to do their bidding. Want to see if that's true?

name: Necro Paragon's Reaver (0 AC)
description: Are you ready to fulfill your destiny and join Dage in the fight for souls and the glory of the Underworld? It's not like you have a choice though.

name: Necro Paragon's Reaver (AC)
description: Are you ready to fulfill your destiny and join Dage in the fight for souls and the glory of the Underworld? It's not like you have a choice though.

name: Necro Paragon's Slasher Axe (0 AC)
description: Are you ready to fullfill your destiny and join Dage in the fight for souls and the glory of the Underworld? It's not like you have a choice though.

name: Necro Paragon's Slasher Axe (AC)
description: Are you ready to fullfill your destiny and join Dage in the fight for souls and the glory of the Underworld? It's not like you have a choice though.

name: Necro University Hammer
description: Do not ask what this Necro University Sorcerer had to do to get to the head of the class…. O_O (Item is color-customizable.)

name: NecroStorm Lich's Scroll
description: Channeling elemental energy siphoned from the storms that tear through the peaks of Thunderfang Spire, the Lightning Necromancers that rule there terrify all who oppose them. Their threat? Unleashing the NecroStorm!

name: Necrotic Chancla of Doom
description: One of the most terrifying doom spirits known to Lore possesses this Chancla. Luckily, its brethren collectively decided to ignore its existence.

name: Necrotic Mace of Misery
description: Once they were standing in the battlefield… and now their bodies lay in a pile, stacking up for the masses to see!

name: Necrotic Pestilence Hammer
description: Twisted rage stares out at you from each side of this decaying mace. The only way to distract the faces' irate, hypnotic glaring is to SMASH THEM into your enemies!

name: Necrowave Guitar
description: Nicknamed "The Crossroad" after the place this deadly guitar was tuned by undead hands. Did the Necrostar make a deal with Evil to get otherworldly music talent? Or were they so skilled that the realm of the dead claimed them for eternity?

name: Nekonomicon
description: Truly? The orginal tome of ancient kitty yarns and forbidden mews?

name: Nekosmasher Mace
description: Of course the Nekomancer's weapon is a yarn ball!

name: Nemesis Mace
description: Modeled after samples of a mace, obtained from the Lore of AdventureQuest, this vicious and powerful mace was wielded by Nemesis and was designed to lacerate flesh from bone!

name: Netherworld Comedian Cards
description: A hand full of jokers.

name: Netherworld Comedian Hammer
description: Do any of you kids use hammers on nails anymore? Hitting heads isn't funny anymore if everyone's doing it.

name: Newsparchment
description: Before the era of Design Notes, bleached pieces of parchment kept the heroes of Lore informed with daily updates. Glad to see people recycle nowadays.

name: Nightmare Battle Umbrella
description: The weather around harvest time can be unpredictable. Best wear layers, and don't forget your umbrella! (Umbrella opens in battle)

name: Nightmare Fiend Sawblade (0 AC)
description: You can't hide from the reach of the Nation. Their Fiends can even invade your dreams. If you have the ability to see further than mortal eyes, they'll turn you into one of them.

name: Nightmare Fiend Sawblade (AC)
description: You can't hide from the reach of the Nation. Their Fiends can even invade your dreams. If you have the ability to see further than mortal eyes, they'll turn you into one of them.

name: Nightmare Mace
description: The deadly mace of the Nightmare Plate.

name: Noble Emissary's Tome
description: The trust and respect of an ancient Vampire clan is priceless. Your eternal loyalty, gratitude, and service to them is the price.

name: Nobles Mace
description: Combines the shiny gold a noble craves with the sharp edges a warrior needs!

name: North Star
description: Ice as hard as diamond, and as sharp as a knife can have only one use… to decimate your enemies!

name: Northern Wanderer Staff (AC)
description: Can break through even the strongest ice.

name: Northern Wanderer Staff (Special)
description: Can break through even the strongest ice.

name: Northlands Hockey Stick
description: Hey, that's a high stick! I'm blowing the whistle! Celebrate your victory in the Icestorm Cup finals!

name: Nugget NOM NOM NOM
description: NOM NOM Nuggets.

name: Nugget on a Stick
description: NOM NOM NOM Nuggets.

name: Nulgath's LatoLato
description: Made from the carved scales of a Sulphur Dracolich, these look like a toy… to the unwary. When the weighted ends of the latolato strike, the pain will be real. And Nulgath will laugh at you.

name: Number 0 - Inert Beacon
description: A recovered Beacon with its energy safely and permanently contained. To most, it looks like a head of lettuce. To Beacon Hunters, even an Inert Beacon holds enough power to defeat their toughest foes.

name: Number 2 Pencil
description: Stab'em with the pointy end. (Then takes notes on how you did in battle.)

name: Nursey's Wedding Bouquet
description: Flowers: 5500 gold. Telling everyone, "I'm next." Priceless.

name: Nythera Plushie Mace
description: It roars if you get too close. But you can't fear something so cute, can you?

name: Nythera's Void Stone
description: An orb pulsing with magic that few can control or understand. Nythera gave one to you, trusting that you would master it.

name: Oasis Storm Armblade
description: These blades move quicker than a sandstorm, and cut apart any that dare to defile the oasis tomb of the Deified Pharaoh of Storms.

name: Obake

description: Tasty, but very strong, berry juice. You'd better take a taxi after this one.

name: Yurei Ladle
description: A ship ladle carried by the Funa-yurei. Make sure to poke holes in the bottom…

name: Zard Crossing Sign (Mace)
description: WATCH OUT (for baby zards)!

name: Zard Haunch
description: Zards are yummy… but it is recommended to cook them WELL.

name: Zardbane
description: A massively powerful weapon that deals extra damage to Zards. Well… 800 years ago, it works like that. At least it still looks cool!

name: Zardian Pilot Olfactory Tool
description: These are sensitive tools given to the Zardian's human compatriots to make up for their abysmal senses. Most will admit not knowing how to properly use them, and restoring to swinging them around like a bat instead.

name: Zardman's StoneHammer
description: This belonged to a Zardman warrior once.

name: Zealith Doom Reaver
description: Did… SWAGGY borrow Dage's Zealith Reavers for the Wheel? What happened to the other one? And who painted it red?! That… that IS paint, right? So many questions!

name: Zealous Censer
description: Warriors for Good in the time of Stellaria, these Paladins went fearlessly into battle against the Cryptborg's forces of NecroDrones and NecroMechs. There… they met their fate. Do not let their sacrifice be in vain!

name: Zep's Umbrella
description: During Carnaval, everyone comes out to party! Even a certain famous lady with a delicious hat - and her dance partner!

name: Zephyrus Manifesto
description: A book as old as the Air Dragon's, use the knowledge written here to unlock more secrets of Airstorm and mayhap a cure.

name: Zombie Slayer Hammer
description: Looks like you've been shopping at S-Mart.

name: Zorbak Plushie Mace
description: Mehehehehehe.
